description: Acquires and verifies exact center-filtered Tennessee DHS/STS GIS records with publisher metadata as immutable local-review evidence; not a national registry contribution or all-childcare census.

offline_recovery.input: Explicit failed industry receipt, exact retained staging path and SHA-256 pins for receipt, selected features, source observations and publisher XML. No caller-selected network source.
offline_recovery.postal_gap_handling: Unavailable source ZIPs become null zip_code, postal_code and zip4 with explicit quality reasons; coordinates and Census geography never supply an invented USPS ZIP.
offline_recovery.lineage: Preserve byte-identical source evidence, failed receipt and failure log; independently replay original quality failure and recovered normalization. Original observation time is separate from processing time.
offline_recovery.limits: Same acquisition replay bounds and five-percent quarantine gate; exclusive publication lock, immutable run identity, no automatic lock recovery or acquisition retry. National reporting integration remains separate.

output_schema_contract.verification: scripts/verify-tn-childcare.mjs accepts an immutable manifest path and replays retained acquisition evidence and normalization; no current.json input or provider request.
output_schema_contract.postal_fields: physical_address.zip_code and postal_code contain ZIP5 only; physical_address.zip4 contains a separate four-digit string or null.
output_schema_contract.geocode: Normalized business records contain nullable latitude/longitude only, EPSG:4326. Source points remain internal evidence; broad TN bounds are not verified state/county boundary membership.
output_schema_contract.source_filter: Provider_Status = 'Active' AND Provider_Type = 'Child Care' AND Child_Care_Type = 'Child Care Center'

redirect_policy: Reject redirects. Fixed production Active_ChildCare_Locations FeatureServer/0 and query, fixed item, organization and raw metadata XML URLs only. No caller URL, SQL, outFields or scope override; metadata links are not followed.
retry: Three bounded attempts only for transient transport/timeouts, 429 and 5xx. Header/body deadlines and one-second observation spacing apply. Honor Retry-After; waits over 60000ms defer instead of shortening. Scope/schema/private-field drift, cancellation and quality failures are not retried. CLI exposes no transport/limit overrides.
checkpoint: Complete before/after preflight retains layer, item, organization and unchanged raw XML with fixed-filter counts; unique ID inventories bracket selected batches. Replay exact selected evidence and normalization offline. Matching observations are not transactional snapshot isolation. No acquisition resume or automatic crash recovery is implemented.
idempotency: Each publication has a fresh immutable UUID run/release; preserve retained selected records, metadata and hashes. No source freshness reuse, business deduplication, lifecycle comparison or closure inference is implied.
cancellation: Cooperative CLI signals and parent IPC cancel requests, waits and precommit work. Clean only owned staging on cooperative precommit cancellation, preserve ordinary failure evidence and prior/sibling releases. Exclusive ownership protects publication; complete the final commit without cooperative interruption. Abrupt termination or disk failure requires inspection; do not reclaim stale locks automatically.
retention_profile: Immutable internal selected source, full publisher metadata and acquisition observations; local-review-only normalized records. Operator-governed deletion, no automatic cleanup.
